decision: Need structured competitive-intel / audience-intel scanning capability for researcher
rationale: First researcher heartbeat (2026-04-24) surfaced that no scenario/CLI exists for structured external scanning: X/Twitter search, GitHub topic/trending, competitor pricing pages, industry-blog RSS. seo-optimizer is keyword-focused, not competitor-monitoring. Without structured scanning, researcher must rely on manual reads which are slow, hard to triangulate (≥3 converging scans needed for audience-update), and high fabrication risk. Workaround recorded at docs/marketing/notebook/AUDIENCE_OBSERVATIONS.md (2026-04-24 entry). Scope hint for director-swarm: a competitive-intel scenario covering (a) structured scrape of competitor pricing/catalog pages with diff detection, (b) X/Twitter keyword+author search with stable pagination, (c) GitHub topic/repo monitoring. This unblocks audience-update proposals, monetization-benchmark-adjacent cross-team feeds, and market-validator's BENCHMARKS.md population.
notes: Scope-hint accepted. Spawns: (1) new competitive-intel initiative (also monetizable as standalone product); (2) new browser-automation-studio-readiness initiative paralleling web-console-readiness, with self-healing research (browser-use as ref) + AI feature audit + feedback pipeline; competitive-intel depends on BAS-readiness. Both surface together because researcher and market-validator independently asked for the same substrate.
